name: dynamic method results retain fresh optional tuple and async aliases
source: class Factory { last: number[] = []; fresh(): number[] { const result: number[] = [1]; this.last = result; return result; } optional(present: boolean): number[] | undefined { return present ? this.last : undefined; } pair(): [number[], number[]] { return [this.last, this.last]; } async delayed(): Promise<number[]> { await Promise.resolve(); return this.last; } } async function main(): Promise<void> { const factory = new Factory(); const exposed: any = factory; const result: any = exposed.fresh(); console.log(result === factory.last, exposed.optional(true) === result, exposed.optional(false) === undefined); const pair: any = exposed.pair(); console.log(pair[0] === result, pair[1] === result); const delayed: any = await exposed.delayed(); delayed[0] = 9; console.log(delayed === result, factory.last[0]); }
